rows.information: Indian Institute of Technology Delhi (Industrial Research & Development Unit)
Principal Project Scientist, Senior Project Scientist
By email, using Form No. IRD/REC-4

content_sections.heading: Project Details
content_sections.text: The project looks at how developers of utility-scale solar and wind projects in India engage with local communities, handle socio-environmental tensions and mobilise global capital to scale up renewable energy. It uses surveys and interviews in different local settings. The study will add to ongoing research at IIT Delhi on community engagement and equity in siting renewable energy projects. content_sections.heading: IIT Delhi Principal Project Scientist and Senior Project Scientist Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The notice prints the pay as a slab: Rs. 75,600 to Rs. 1,01,610 for the Principal Project Scientist and Rs. 60,750 to Rs. 79,260 for the Senior Project Scientist. If the selected candidate is a retired or superannuated government employee, the salary will be fixed under the prevailing IRD norms.

content_sections.heading: IIT Delhi Principal Project Scientist and Senior Project Scientist Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Only Indian nationals can apply. Essential qualification: Ph.D. with first class or equivalent in economics, energy systems, innovation studies, public policy, political science, sociology, engineering, or a related discipline. OR: MTech with 1st class, MSc with 1st class, or an equivalent degree in economics, energy systems, innovation studies, public policy, political science, sociology, engineering, or a related discipline, with 6 years of experience in related areas, from a reputed university. Required skillset: Strong aptitude for independent research. This includes formulating and refining research questions, developing suitable methods, managing research with limited supervision and taking a leading role in producing high-quality academic outputs. Experience of mixed-methods research, such as survey design, interviews, data analysis and conjoint analysis. Desirable: Evidence of independent research through publications, working papers, research projects or similar outputs (highly desirable). Experience in the energy sector, project finance or energy technologies, and industry contacts. Essential qualification: MTech/MS (or an equivalent technical degree) with 1st class, OR BTech/MSc/Post graduate with 1st class in a relevant discipline, with 3 years of experience in economics, energy systems, innovation studies, public policy, political science, sociology, engineering, or a related discipline, from a reputed university. Required skillset: Experience of mixed-methods research, including survey design, interviews, data analysis and conjoint analysis. Desirable: Strong quantitative and data-analysis skills. Experience in the energy sector, financial databases, project finance or energy technologies, and industry contacts. Interest in developing research skills and possibly doing a PhD or following a research career. SC/ST candidates may be given a 5% relaxation of marks. If no candidate is found suitable, the Selection Committee may downgrade a post. Check the official notification for the full eligibility for each post.

content_sections.heading: Duties of the Selected Candidates
content_sections.text: The notice lists the same work for both posts: Examine how environmental, social, permitting and community-related factors affect the development, financing and implementation of energy and infrastructure projects. Help design and run a survey of energy-sector developers to collect primary data on renewable energy firms' cost of capital, financing conditions, environmental and social risks, and community opposition. Combine survey evidence with financial and project-level datasets to study links between cost of capital, project risk, environmental and social factors, and community acceptance. Do literature reviews across energy finance, innovation studies, project development, environmental risk and community acceptance, and contribute to academic papers, reports and presentations. Produce clear visualisations and present the findings to academic and policy audiences (Principal Project Scientist). The notice says the Senior Project Scientist post offers the chance to contribute to academic publications and gain experience in interdisciplinary research on energy, finance, policy, technology and sustainability.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: IIT Delhi may set higher criteria to shortlist eligible candidates from those who meet the advertised qualifications and requirements. The names of shortlisted candidates and the interview details will be shown on the IIT Delhi IRD shortlisted candidates page. The interview will be held in person. Only shortlisted candidates will be informed.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The appointment is on a contract basis with consolidated pay. It is renewable every year or lasts up to the duration of the project, whichever is earlier. The project runs until 31 December 2027.

faq.question: Q1. How many posts has IIT Delhi advertised under IITD/IRD/308/2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 posts: 1 Principal Project Scientist and 1 Senior Project Scientist, both in the School of Public Policy.

faq.question: Q2. Can I apply for the Principal Project Scientist post without a Ph.D.?
faq.answer: Yes. MTech with 1st class, MSc with 1st class or an equivalent degree in a listed field also qualifies, but you also need 6 years of experience in related areas.

faq.question: Q3. How much experience does the Senior Project Scientist post need?
faq.answer: 3 years of experience in economics, energy systems, innovation studies, public policy, political science, sociology, engineering or a related discipline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the pay for the Senior Project Scientist?
faq.answer: A consolidated fellowship of Rs. 60,750 to Rs. 79,260 a month, plus HRA at 30%.

faq.question: Q5. Which form do I need?
faq.answer: Form No. IRD/REC-4, from the IRD website (ird.iitd.ac.in/rec). You send it with your CV and cover letter as one PDF.

faq.question: Q6. What should I name the PDF file?
faq.answer: Use the post you are applying for and your last name, for example "Principal Project Scientist -Khanna.pdf".

faq.question: Q7. Is there any relaxation for SC/ST candidates?
faq.answer: Yes. SC/ST candidates may be given a 5% relaxation of marks.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the interview be held, and how will I know if I am shortlisted?
faq.answer: The interview is in person. Shortlisted names and interview details will be posted on ird.iitd.ac.in/shortlisted, and only shortlisted candidates will be informed.

faq.question: Q9. How long will the appointment last?
faq.answer: It is a contract, renewable every year or up to the end of the project, whichever is earlier. The project runs until 31 December 2027.

faq.question: Q10. Who funds the project?
faq.answer: Giving Green funds the project. Prof. Kaveri K. Iychettira of the School of Public Policy is the Project Investigator.
